welcome_message: Welcome to the CABI User Portal!
hero_subtitle: Safe, reliable, and transparent rides at your fingertips.
stats_subtitle: Our network grows daily, connecting verified drivers and passengers nationwide.
newsletter_subtitle: Get the latest updates and executive offers from CABI.
drivers_hero_title: Drive with CABI, Earn on Your Terms
drivers_hero_subtitle: Take control of your schedule and your income. Join our community of vetted professional drivers today.
drivers_flexibility_desc: You are in charge. Drive full-time or part-time whenever it fits your schedule. Go online and earn on your own terms.
drivers_earnings_desc: Keep a fair share of every fare, and unlock recurring income streams by growing your driver network through Business Builder.
drivers_payouts_desc: Access your earnings without waiting. Our reliable payout infrastructure settles directly via mobile money with zero unnecessary delays.
passengers_hero_title: Your Journey, Your Way. Safe and Reliable.
passengers_hero_subtitle: Get where you need to go with comfort and peace of mind.
passengers_booking_desc: Our intuitive app lets you book a ride in seconds. Simply enter your destination and we'll match you with a verified driver.
passengers_safety_desc: Your safety is our top priority. Track your trip in real time, share your ride status with loved ones, and rely on built-in safety features.
passengers_reliability_desc: Backed by a vetted network of professional drivers, you can count on CABI for a dependable, comfortable ride day or night.
